q: What was the total PBS cost in FY2026?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026

q: How many prescriptions were supplied in FY2025?
sql: SELECT SUM(scripts) AS scripts FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2025

q: How much did the government pay in FY2024?
sql: SELECT SUM(govt_cost) AS govt_cost FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2024

q: What was the total cost in the 2024-25 financial year?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2025

q: 2025/26 财年的政府支出是多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(govt_cost) AS govt_cost FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026

q: Which drug group had the highest total cost in the latest year?
sql: SELECT atc1_name, SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many prescriptions were there in the most recent year?
sql: SELECT SUM(scripts) AS scripts FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026

q: What share of total cost did patients pay in FY2026?
sql: SELECT SUM(patient_cost) / SUM(total_cost) AS patient_share FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026

q: What was the average total cost per prescription in FY2023 and FY2026?
sql: SELECT fin_year, SUM(total_cost) / SUM(scripts) AS cost_per_script FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year IN (2023, 2026) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

q: 患者自付比例在 FY2023 是多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(patient_cost) / SUM(total_cost) AS patient_share FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2023

q: By what percentage did total cost grow from FY2023 to FY2026?
sql: SELECT (SUM(total_cost) FILTER (WHERE fin_year = 2026) / SUM(total_cost) FILTER (WHERE fin_year = 2023) - 1) * 100 AS growth_pct FROM monthly_drug

q: How much did prescription volume grow from FY2023 to FY2026, in percent?
sql: SELECT (SUM(scripts) FILTER (WHERE fin_year = 2026) * 1.0 / SUM(scripts) FILTER (WHERE fin_year = 2023) - 1) * 100 AS growth_pct FROM monthly_drug

q: Which drug group's total cost grew fastest between FY2025 and FY2026 (in percent)?
sql: SELECT atc1_name, (SUM(total_cost) FILTER (WHERE fin_year = 2026) / SUM(total_cost) FILTER (WHERE fin_year = 2025) - 1) * 100 AS growth_pct FROM monthly_drug WHERE atc1_code <> 'X' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: What were the top 5 drugs by total cost in FY2026?
sql: SELECT drug_name, SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026 AND drug_name <> '99999Z' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

q: Which drug had the most prescriptions in FY2026?
sql: SELECT drug_name, SUM(scripts) AS scripts FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026 AND drug_name <> '99999Z' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: FY2026 政府支出最高的 3 种药是什么？
sql: SELECT drug_name, SUM(govt_cost) AS govt_cost FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026 AND drug_name <> '99999Z' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

q: How much was spent on semaglutide in FY2026?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026 AND UPPER(drug_name) LIKE '%SEMAGLUTIDE%'

q: How many scripts of pembrolizumab were supplied in FY2025?
sql: SELECT SUM(scripts) AS scripts FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2025 AND UPPER(drug_name) LIKE '%PEMBROLIZUMAB%'

q: What share of FY2026 total cost went to cancer and immune drugs?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_cost) FILTER (WHERE atc1_code = 'L') / SUM(total_cost) AS share FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026

q: Which drug group had the most prescriptions in FY2026?
sql: SELECT atc1_name, SUM(scripts) AS scripts FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: How much did concessional patients' prescriptions cost in total in FY2026?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026 AND scheme_group = 'Concessional'

q: What was the patient share of cost for General patients in FY2026?
sql: SELECT SUM(patient_cost) / SUM(total_cost) AS patient_share FROM monthly_drug WHERE fin_year = 2026 AND scheme_group = 'General'

q: In which calendar month of 2025 was total cost highest?
sql: SELECT cal_month, SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost FROM monthly_drug WHERE cal_year = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: What was the total cost in December 2025?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost FROM monthly_drug WHERE month_start = DATE '2025-12-01'

q: Compared with the year before, how much did government cost change in the latest year, in percent?
sql: SELECT (SUM(govt_cost) FILTER (WHERE fin_year = 2026) / SUM(govt_cost) FILTER (WHERE fin_year = 2025) - 1) * 100 AS growth_pct FROM monthly_drug
